name: Kiosk Fleet Proxy
description: Serve every kiosk in a fleet from one origin so the built-in device switcher works inside a dashboard iframe. Routes /<kiosk id>/ to each kiosk, rewrites fleet links in HTTP responses and WebSocket messages, and adds the frame-ancestors policy the admin server does not send.
author: Hotshot

settings.title: Origins allowed to frame this page
settings.description: Space separated origins, for example https://dashboard.example. Left empty, only this origin may frame the page. The origin this kiosk is reached on comes from the request Host header.
